description: Fetch supported blockchain networks and static parameters from `GET /v1/chains`. `methods.allow` and `methods.deny` support wildcard patterns where `deny` takes precedence over `allow`. `state_window_blocks` indicates the historical state window in blocks for state queries (null when full history is available); `max_logs_block_range` limits `eth_getLogs`: the range is inclusive, so `toBlock - fromBlock + 1` must not exceed it, otherwise the call fails with `logs_range_too_large`. `public` describes the keyless endpoint: `public.url` serves only the methods in `public.methods`, and `public.history_blocks` is how far back a block reference may reach on that endpoint (it does not add methods). Pass `chain` (a slug such as `base_mainnet`) to return only that chain.

chain.description: Optional chain slug (exact match, e.g. 'base_mainnet'). When set, only that chain is returned; unknown slugs return an error listing the available ones. Omit to list all chains.

name: list_chains

max_logs_block_range.description: Max block span of one eth_getLogs request. Both ends are inclusive: toBlock - fromBlock + 1 must not exceed this value, otherwise the call returns logs_range_too_large.

history_blocks.description: How many blocks back a block reference may reach on the keyless public.url. It applies only to methods in public.methods and does not add methods.

title: List Supported Chains
